📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #729.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume in the alert window vs the same window 24h ago — if delta < 20%, it's the chronic pattern (no new incident). 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath: if dominant paths are all under upstream microservices.methodlocal.int, it's pool-level. 3) Check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first — DNS bursts can present as Ocelot timeouts. 4) If DNS is clean, identify the slow downstream microservice via ms-gateway-api/gateway/API/ocelot.*.json. 5) Fix options: raise per-route Ocelot timeout, scale/recycle the microservices IIS pool, or profile the upstream microservice.
Open Jira: n/a — not present on this KB entry
